faq.q: Les prix de l'immobilier baissent-ils à Bruxelles en 2026 ?

faq.q: Est-ce le bon moment pour vendre à Bruxelles ?

faq.q: Combien vaut ma maison à Bruxelles ?

faq.q: Are property prices falling in Brussels in 2026?
faq.a: No. According to the notaries' Q3 2026 barometer, the average house price in Brussels reached €609,227 (+4.8%) and the average apartment price €301,666 (+1.7%) over the first nine months of the year.

faq.q: Is it a good time to sell in Brussels?
faq.a: Brussels prices are high and the number of sales is stable, unlike in Wallonia. Rising interest rates do reduce buyers' budgets, so if your decision to sell is made, there is little point in postponing it.

faq.q: How much is my house in Brussels worth?
faq.a: The regional average is not enough: value depends on the municipality, neighbourhood, condition, EPC and recent comparable sales. Diamant Consult provides a free, no-obligation valuation anywhere in Brussels.
